topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Found all sorts o' things in the attic, things the last folk left behind. Old cloaks and boots, books with pages as yellow as the sun at harvest, and a box of trinkets, shiny bits and pieces that catch the light. Never thought I'd find a chest full o' tales in my own roof! There's an old watch, its hands frozen, and a bundle of letters tied with a ribbon, faded but still readable. Each one feels like a story, a piece of their lives. I reckon they had more than just the land to tend; they had stories to keep. reckon I'll be sorting through this for a while, learning about the folks who once called this place home.
